changelog:
Initial release of Diff Wizard: a format-aware diff and merge tool with AI explanations.

- Compare and merge JSON, YAML, CSV, code, and plain text with high accuracy.
- Detects format automatically; provides field-level, row/column, semantic, or DOM-based diffs.
- Supports 3-way merge with conflict resolution and AI-powered suggestions.
- Offers terminal color output and multiple export formats (markdown, HTML, JSON, unified diff).
- Built-in interactive paste mode, directory batch comparison, and robust error handling.
- AI explanations available in English or Chinese; all processing is performed locally for security.
summary: Smart text comparison tool with format-aware diffing, AI explanation, and 3-way merge. Covers structured JSON, YAML, CSV, code, and plain text.
